title: Continuous Risk-Based Scheduling for Food Safety Inspection: Integrating Historical Decay with Event-Driven Consumer Review Signals
abstract: arXiv:2610.15191v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Batch risk-based inspection scheduling struggles to detect a critical failure class: food facilities with recent clean inspections that subsequently develop severe violations. Traditional systems recompute risk on fixed planning cycles using static historical data, leaving blind spots between inspection cycles. To address this, we introduce the Continuous Inspection Risk (CIR) system, an event-driven scheduling pipeline that re-ranks the inspection queue dynamically as new data arrives. CIR combines a decay-weighted historical score with a stream of real-time consumer reviews triaged by a language-model classifier. A key structural contribution is our temporal partition rule, which strictly excludes reviews predating the most recent inspection to prevent superseded signals from skewing current risk. translated_title: 面向食品安全检查的连续风险调度：融合历史衰减与事件驱动的消费者评论信号
translated_abstract: 基于批处理的风险检查调度难以发现一类关键的失效情形：即近期检查合格、但随后出现严重违规的食品设施。传统系统在固定的规划周期内使用静态历史数据重新计算风险，导致检查周期之间存在盲区。为解决这一问题，我们提出了连续检查风险（CIR）系统，这是一个事件驱动的调度流水线，可在新数据到达时动态重新排序检查队列。CIR 将衰减加权的历史评分与经语言模型分类器分流的实时消费者评论流相结合。一个关键的结构性贡献是我们的时间分区规则，该规则严格排除早于最近一次检查的评论，以防止已被替代的信号干扰当前的风险评估。我们在加利福尼亚州圣克拉拉县的 9,505 次例行检查（2024-2026 年）上对 CIR 进行了评估，结果表明仅基于历史的评分可以减少……（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出连续检查风险（CIR）系统，通过将衰减加权的历史评分与语言模型分类的实时消费者评论流相结合，在新数据到达时动态重排食品安全检查队列，并采用时间分区规则排除过时评论信号以提升风险检测的时效性。
en_tdlr: The paper introduces the Continuous Inspection Risk (CIR) system, an event-driven pipeline that dynamically re-ranks food safety inspection queues by combining decay-weighted historical scores with real-time, language-model-classified consumer reviews, and employs a temporal partition rule to exclude outdated review signals.
